:::{#exm-logistic-function}
#### Values of the logistic function

The logistic function of @def-logistic-function at $z = -2$, $0$ and $2$:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
z <- c(-2, 0, 2)
data.frame(z = z, sigmoid = 1 / (1 + exp(-z)))
```

The value at $z = 0$ is $1 / (1 + e^0) = 1/2$.
The values at $-2$ and $2$ add to 1,
and both lie strictly between 0 and 1.
:::
